Question: Sweden’s defense chief said a Russian attack could happen any time. Do you share that concern? 
Swedish Dep PM @BuschEbba: “Make no mistake, Russia will not stop at Ukraine, and the next one that would be on Russia's list is a NATO ally, and that would for sure really test the strength of the alliance.”

Video

In another time, one could imagine urgent public and private messaging from the White House to the Kremlin discouraging another such air assault on Ukraine.


Kateryna Lisunova (@KaterynaLis)

‼️The likelihood of a combined attack is high from Russia tonight. 

A warning remains in effect regarding the possible use of enemy missile weapons against targets across Ukraine.



— https://nitter.net/KaterynaLis/status/2061526802384740814#m

Just in: The Trump administration will abide by a court ruling to pause its creation of a nearly $1.8 billion fund meant to compensate people who say they were wrongly targeted by the government in the past,  the Justice Department said in a statement.

-@CNN reporting
